custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the cut surfaces of the figs. AI often fails to render the complex, granular texture of fig seeds and pulp, resulting in smudged or overly uniform interiors. Also, inspect the wire basket for logical continuity—AI frequently breaks or melts metal grids. Verify that the lighting on the shiny plastic packaging in the background is consistent with the light source illuminating the fruit.

Behind them, a black wire basket holds a pile of whole purple/brown figs. The background shows blurred shelving and packaging, suggesting a grocery store environment.
